<!-- pr-reviewer: 385731fff887197f47cf25c6ed3c445c6a43da42 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change meets issue #1803. It moves the slow test to the release heavy lane. All 17 tests, both tool diameters, the fixture, and all assertions stay unchanged. The decision record explains the choice.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at db091cb38163f3713ce44918ea973855cd0960ad:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run`: passed. All motion test binaries compiled.
- The exact L-shaped test in debug: 1 ignored, with the specified heavy lane reason.
- The exact L-shaped test with `--release --ignored --exact`: 1 passed, 0 failed, in 75.71 seconds.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Quick gate dry run: passed. This was a plan check, not a full gate run.
- Source comparison: only the ignore attribute changed in the test file. All 17 test attributes and the complete test bodies are preserved.

No changes are required before merge. Production code, posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, stock simulation, UI, and goldens do not change. No safety mutations were required. No goldens moved. The release gate includes the motion tests with `--release --ignored`.

The full quick and release gates were not run for this test attribute change. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
